target.statement: PSNR of 32.03 dB for image restoration (chromatic aberration removal) on CelebAMask-HQ, reported as 'Ours' in Table 2 (and Table 1 'CA Re' row)

compute.basis: No authors' code is released (only third-party segmentation repos are linked), so the two GANs (SGAda refinement + EGSyn restoration), the 3-stage cooperative training, and the chromatic-aberration degradation pipeline must all be re-implemented and trained from scratch on 30k 512x512 CelebAMask-HQ images; GAN training of this scale is infeasible on a CPU-only laptop.

blockers: No official code release (paper only promises 'will be publicly available')

title: Cooperative Semantic Segmentation and Image Restoration in Adverse Environmental Conditions
